action.details: Detects the first HTTP or HTTPS URL in the selection and passes it to macOS's Add to Safari Reading List sharing service. Additional links are intentionally ignored.
action.exampleOutput: https://example.com/article is added to Safari Reading List.
action.name: Safari Reading List
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the first URL detected in the selected text to Safari's local Reading List sharing service. Safari and iCloud control any later sync.
action.requirements: Safari Reading List must be available. Select text containing at least one HTTP or HTTPS web address.
action.summary: Add the first selected web link to Safari Reading List.
